test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people K, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only four people sit to the left of P. Q sits third to the left of N. N is not an immediate neighbour of P. M sits third to the left of L. K sits to the immediate left of M. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people K, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north.

1) Only four people sit to the left of P.

2) N is not an immediate neighbour of P.

3) Q sits third to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4b5e4626a142b51c159c8d3342cc5448e9e5ef6581c215e5a2b1f079b210d73.png] 

4) M sits third to the left of L.

5) K sits to the immediate left of M.

And, O will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39239557a47f1bd1338bc1a68dcf9463def35750178a078d62ad9591b07746d5.png] 

Here, 'O' sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
